body: On 2026-10-13 the ubgo/gqlkit GitHub repository was deleted and recreated from a filter-repo rewritten history (a credential had been committed in sample code). Effects: every commit SHA before that date changed; issues and PRs were renumbered (old open issues #2/#3 are now #1/#2; old #4, #5 and PR #1 are gone, cited in docs as 'old issue #N' in plain text); stars reset. Releases and tags were restored with identical file contents, so Go and npm consumers are unaffected.
